skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply general management functions and leadership, including planning, organizing, and controlling.
Identify and address research issues related to business management in practical settings.

Analyze and evaluate the operational status of organizations and businesses, including strategic planning, production, business development, innovation, productivity, quality management, project management, decision-making, business sustainability, etc.

Apply methods and techniques for management tasks at various levels, from leadership to functional management, including environmental analysis, strategic planning, organizational culture building, leadership, business planning, organization and operation, control and evaluation, business improvement, project management, report writing, etc.

Develop soft skills such as creativity, critical thinking, delegation, communication, time management, problem-solving, teamwork, conflict management, negotiation, personal branding, presentation, cultural adaptation, etc.
Understand and comply with legal regulations and organizational rules.
Develop professional ethics and responsibility towards work.

prerequisite_courses: Completion of all courses in the training program
